title: join_as_requested is a started flag set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never cleared by an error or send failure
trigger: Open a video chat while the send fails or the answer errors (error.rs treats it as optional)
effect: The join-as picker is never offered for that tracked call; join goes ahead as yourself
fix: Fetch<JoinAsList> on the call (Idle, Loading(request), Ready, Failed).

title: Call link flow spread over call_link, call_link_confirm and call_link_after_leave
trigger: Open a call link while in another call, confirm leave; or the fetch_group_call after offer_call_link fails
effect: call_link keeps the hash after a failed fetch; call_link_after_leave waits on active_call.is_some(), which stays Some through the 1:1 call's Discarded end screen, so the link is not offered until the user dismisses it; there is no cancel for the queued offer
fix: enum CallLinkFlow { Idle, Confirming(..), LeavingThenOffer(..), Offered(..) } cleared on every exit.

title: Join/transport/screen-share stage held as transport_ready + join_payload + transport_error + rejoin + screen_* fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Join, rejoin, drop and screen-share paths each reset a different subset (join.rs:467-471, stream.rs:559-562, controls.rs:64-68, mod.rs:172-182)
effect: No bug proven beyond the others listed; every new path must remember which fields to clear
fix: enum Transport { NoTransport, Offering, AnswerReady(payload), Connected, Failed(err) } plus a ScreenShare enum, reset together on rejoin.

title: Chat photo emoji icons are icons + chat_photo_emoji_icons_failed + an in-flight purpose
trigger: Open the photo builder, fail, reopen
effect: Reset by hand at load_chat_photo_emoji_icons; no bug today
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>>.

title: Welcome messages: welcome_messages map plus welcome_message_fetches enum plus a pending-purpose check decide one 'is it loading' answer
trigger: load_chat_welcome_messages
effect: dedupe checks contains_key(welcome_messages) OR has_purpose; the Loading marker is a second source of truth
fix: Fold the cached pack into WelcomeMessagesFetch::Ready

title: Join request search uses three maps (join_request_latest, join_request_queries, join_requests=Loading) as one stage
trigger: search_chat_join_requests / load_more_chat_join_requests; load_more treats join_request_latest.contains_key as 'loading'
effect: Stage spread over maps; removed in answer and error arms by hand (error.rs:234-252, apply.rs:479)
fix: Put query and latest request id inside JoinRequestFetch::Loading/Loaded

title: InviteLinkMembersState holds loading:bool, error and request:Option together
trigger: open_chat_invite_link_members / load_more / answer
effect: three fields set by hand in request_invite_link_members (append sets loading/error/request, fresh sets all)
fix: One enum stage carrying the request id

title: Language flow: packs_loading:bool, switching:Option, current:Option, reload:bool, error:Option, ready:Option one-shots
trigger: request_language_packs, switch_language, adopt_saved_language, drain_language
effect: reload is replaced to false by drain_language even when it was not acted on because switching.is_some() (state/.. drain at language_ui.rs:245) so a 'reload' is lost
fix: enum LanguageFlow plus a typed one-shot queue (LanguageEvent) instead of three one-shot fields

title: Language switch: packs_loading, switching{pack,base Options} and four one-shot fields
trigger: n/a
effect: A switch is done when both Options are Some; ready/patch/reload/error are one-shots the UI drains by hand.
fix: enum LanguageStage { Idle, Fetching{info,gen,pack,base}, Ready(..)} plus Fetch<Vec<Pack>> for packs.

title: Gift code lookup is loading/applying/applied/error/info kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a giftcode link, press Use Link; GiftCodeLookup carries loading, applying, applied, error and info together; gift_code_body draws 'applied' and an error together and can_apply recomputes the stage from three of them.
effect: Applied and error can both be set so the box shows 'Premium is now active' and a red error together; the stage is re-derived in the view.
fix: enum GiftCodeStage { Checking, Known(info), Applying(info), Applied(info), Failed(err) }.

title: Language link lookup is loading plus info plus error
trigger: Open a setlanguage link; LanguageLinkLookup has loading, info and error read separately by language_body.
effect: Loading and error can be set together; no bug found today.
fix: Use Fetch<LanguagePackInfo>.

title: Gift code box: loading, applying, applied, error and two request ids
trigger: Open t.me/giftcode/.. link, Apply, error, retry
effect: loading/applying/applied/error/info are set together by apply_gift_code_info/ok/error; applying and apply both encode the same stage; error can coexist with info
fix: enum GiftCode{Checking{request},Ready(info),Applying{request,info},Applied,Failed(reason)}.

title: Language link lookup: loading bool + info + error + request token
trigger: n/a
effect: take_answer clears request and loading; success/error fill info/error.
fix: Fetch<LanguagePackInfoData> with the request id inside the Loading variant.

title: GiftCodeLookup carries applying:bool, applied:bool, apply:Option<RequestId>, error and checking request
trigger: request_gift_code_info / apply_gift_code / answers (payments/gift_code.rs)
effect: Answers appear matched by request id (tests in connect/tests/link_info.rs:206), but stage is still bool flags
fix: enum GiftCodeStage { Checking, Ready(info), Applying{req}, Applied, Failed }

title: OwnershipState::check_in_flight is a bool beside check_error and can_transfer
trigger: Owner leaves/transfers a chat; canTransferOwnership check.
effect: Set true on send, cleared in the error arm, the ok arm and the driver; check_error and can_transfer are cleared by hand.
fix: Use Fetch<CanTransferOwnershipResult>.

title: InviteLinkMembersState and BoostsListState hold loading bool, request id and error together
trigger: Open invite-link members or the boosts list.
effect: The error arm sets loading=false, request=None and error in three writes; loading is redundant with request.is_some().
fix: Replace with a Fetch-like enum carrying the request id (LinkRequestsState already derives loading from request).

title: BoostsListState is loading:bool + error + request:Option kept in step by hand
trigger: open_chat_boosts / load_more_chat_boosts / answer / error arms
effect: append path forgets loading (see 02-P6-001)
fix: enum BoostsPage { Loading{request,append}, Ready, Failed } with the loaded rows kept beside it

title: BoostsListState holds loading: bool, error: Option and request: Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Any boosts load, Show more or error.
effect: loading can be true with an error set, or request Some with loading false (the append path above).
fix: One enum value for the page stage (Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed(String)); LinkRequestsState already derives loading from request and is the model.

title: AdminLinksState keeps InviteLinkFetch next to separate active_request and revoked_request ids
trigger: Open another admin's invite links.
effect: The fetch stage and the id that answers it are two fields that must change together; LinkRequestsState has error beside request, which can both be set.
fix: InviteLinkFetch::Loading(RequestId) carries the request id; join requests use Fetch<Page> with the id inside Loading.

title: OwnershipState is check_in_flight/check_error/can_transfer and transfer_in_flight/transfer_error/transferred as loose fields
trigger: begin_ownership_check, accept_can_transfer_ownership and the error arm each set three fields; begin/finish/fail_ownership_transfer set three more; the UI clears transfer_error/transferred by hand when the dialog opens.
effect: No bug found beyond the lost-answer case below; the stages are not a value.
fix: `Fetch<CanTransferOwnershipResult>` for the check and `enum Transfer { Idle, Sending(OwnershipTransfer), Failed(String), Done(OwnershipTransfer) }`.

title: Marketplace gift purchase is loading/sending/completed bools plus a note, seeded by hand in the demo
trigger: Gift marketplace box
effect: No bug found in this shard; the demo builds GiftPurchase with loading:false, sending:false, completed:false, so any combination of the three can exist
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Quoting, Quoted(GiftQuote), Sending, Completed, Failed(String) }.

title: Storage statistics are an Option plus storage_stats_loading bool, set together by hand
trigger: Settings > Data and storage
effect: No bug found here; the demo sets storage_stats = Some(..) and storage_stats_loading = false separately
fix: Use Fetch<StorageStats> (idle/loading/ready/failed).

title: GiftPurchase is loading + sending + completed + note + quote/price Options
trigger: fetch_marketplace_gift / buy_marketplace_gift / answers in payments/apply.rs:102-160 and error.rs:48
effect: Stages are bools set/cleared in three places; money (Stars/TON) is spent in this flow, answers matched by purpose only, not request id
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Loading{req}, Quoted, Sending{req}, Sent, Failed } and match answers by request id

title: GiftPurchase stage is loading, sending, completed bools beside quote, price and note
trigger: Open a Marketplace gift, load a name, buy it
effect: none found today; Stars/TON money flow rests on loading/sending/completed staying exclusive and on the UI separately holding marketplace_open
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Loading, Quoted{quote,price}, Sending{price}, Sent, Failed(note) } held by the session; the note derived from the stage.

title: MasksState keeps open, strip_wanted, failed, installed_loaded, archived_loaded, set_requested as independent flags
trigger: open_mask_sets, load_editor_masks, pump_masks on every ingest
effect: failed is shared by installed and archived lists; set_requested is cleared only on list change
fix: Per-list Fetch<T> for installed/archived plus a per-set Fetch for the strip; open/strip as one 'wanted' enum

title: Forwarding: in_flight_forward:Option plus queued_forward_flights:Vec as a hand-run queue
trigger: forward_messages_with_options (share box to several chats)
effect: First takes the slot, the rest queue; promotion happens in session_forward.rs:168-176; session_updates clears both
fix: Single Vec<ForwardFlight> with a state per flight (Sending/Done), no special 'main' slot

title: Account/chat export: Option<Export> as the 'running' flag, WorkerLink.pending Option as in-flight request
trigger: start_account_export / pump_export / answer
effect: Guard `account_export.is_some()` means 'running' until the UI clears it; fail_send/answer must clear link.pending
fix: enum ExportStage { Idle, Running(handle), Finished(result) } owned by the box

title: WorkerLink lifecycle is spread over pending: Option<RequestId>, an AtomicBool cancelled and an 'ended' channel whose disconnect means done
trigger: Any chat or account export: running() = !cancelled && !ended, idle_or_cancelled() = pending.is_none() || cancelled, and the UI separately reads Progress.stage (Finished/Failed/Cancelled) written by the worker thread.
effect: Four independent signals (link.pending, link.cancelled, link.ended, progress.stage) must agree; they disagree after a worker panic or a request timeout (see 03-P3-001 and 03-P3-003).
fix: One ExportRun enum owned by the session (Starting, Running{awaiting}, Cancelling, Ended(outcome)) written by the pump and by a worker-ended notice, with progress as data inside Running.

title: Send pipeline: history paging and sends use open_chat/open_topic ambient state (send_topic only knows the topic for session.open_chat) with SendPlace as the fix for deferred voice/video notes only
trigger: send_animation, send_sticker, send_album_snapshot, send_paid_media_snapshot, send_snapshot compute send_topic/thread_routed at call time
effect: Safe only while callers wrap in in_view_of/with_window_chat; every new caller must remember to
fix: Pass SendPlace (fixed at Send) to every send function, as the voice/video-note _to variants do

title: Rich HTML exports live in settings.rich_html_exports with outcome() Option as the stage
trigger: Save a message as HTML, switch account.
effect: The exports Vec is held in session.settings (per account, good) and the stage is outcome().is_none(); finished ones are reaped only when take_finished_rich_html_exports is called, so an export that finishes while the lock screen is shown or the driver is not polled keeps its worker handle.
fix: A RichHtmlExport stage enum (Running, Done, Failed) reaped in the per-account tick.

title: Rich HTML export stage is an Option<RichHtmlOutcome> behind Arc<Mutex> that callers poll; running is None
trigger: Save as HTML on a rich message
effect: No bug today: OutcomeSlot::drop guarantees Failed on panic and start_rich_html_export treats None as running
fix: enum ExportStage { Running, Done(RichHtmlOutcome) } held by the export and taken once by the driver.

title: Event log state is spread over event_logs, event_log_waits{page,poll}, queries, filters, users maps
trigger: Open Recent actions, filter, scroll, poll every 5 s.
effect: A page request and a poll request are tracked as two Options per chat that are cleared by hand in refresh_chat_event_log; filters change in four maps that must be followed by a refresh.
fix: One EventLog per chat holding query, filter, fetch stage and in-flight page/poll ids.

title: Member list stage is supergroup_members Fetch + supergroup_member_queries (extra, query) + note_member_more + pending scan
trigger: Search members, scroll, change the query while a request is in flight.
effect: The query the list belongs to is kept in a second map, the next-page flag is derived by scanning all pending requests (members_more.rs:7), and the first page and next page share one key.
fix: A MemberList per (chat, filter) holding query, fetch stage and optional next-page request id.

title: Ownership transfer is check_in_flight bool + can_transfer Option + transfer_in_flight Option
trigger: Open the transfer ownership dialog.
effect: The check is gated by a bool; the error arm clears it (groups/error.rs:42), but check_in_flight is not tied to the chat, so opening the dialog for another chat while one is in flight reuses its result.
fix: Ownership stage enum keyed by chat (Idle, Checking(RequestId), Ok, Blocked(reason), Transferring(RequestId)).

title: Owned-bot edit and create dialogs track stages with Vec<RequestId>, pending_* Options and generation counters
trigger: Edit a bot name and about, create a managed bot.
effect: BotEditTexts has loads, saves, pending_name, pending_about, error; CreateBotState has generation, check_pending, check_username, creating, created, error. Several fields change together.
fix: A Save enum per field (Idle, Saving(RequestId), Failed) and a CreateBot enum (Idle, Checking, Creating, Created).

title: Create Bot dialog stage is check_pending, creating, created, error and check options
trigger: Create Bot dialog: type username, create
effect: Stage spread over check_pending/creating/created/error/check; BotEditTexts likewise holds load_failed bool beside name/about options and loads vec
fix: enum CreateBot{Editing{check:Fetch<..>},Creating{gen},Created(user),Failed(msg)} and Fetch<(name,about)> for the edit texts

title: Create bot: dialog.submitted mirrors session create.creating and a 150 ms poll task drives it
trigger: Fill the dialog, press Create
effect: BotCreateDialog::submitted is set by hand and reset by poll_bot_create when CreateBotState::creating becomes None; created/error/creating/check_pending/check live in the Session and a spawn_screen timer loop polls them every 150 ms until settled
fix: One CreateStage enum (Editing, Creating, Failed(msg), Done(id)) in the dialog fed by the answer, no polling

title: Paid trust file state is trust_loaded + trust_dirty bools; save errors are ignored
trigger: Press Do not ask again; the write fails (disk full, read-only).
effect: save_paid_trust drops the io error; the trust is kept in memory for the session only, silently lost on restart (user is asked again, no money risk). trust_loaded is a once flag, trust_dirty a pending flag.
fix: A TrustFile stage enum (NotLoaded, Clean, Dirty, SaveFailed) with an error shown on failure.

title: Paid trust persistence is two bools kept in step by hand (trust_loaded, trust_dirty)
trigger: load_paid_trust sets trust_loaded before reading the file; sync_paid_guard clears trust_dirty before save_paid_trust writes (write errors ignored).
effect: A failed trust write leaves trust_dirty false, so the forgotten price is never retried and returns after restart (the user is not asked again for a price the user stopped paying). trust_loaded true with a failed read means an unreadable file is treated as empty and later overwritten.
fix: enum TrustStore { Unloaded, Loaded(PaidTrust), Dirty(PaidTrust) } with the save result deciding whether it returns to Loaded.

title: StarPacksState is open + loading + loaded + error
trigger: Open Buy more Stars.
effect: Four fields move together; the answer is not keyed, the error arm (error.rs:94) clears loading but leaves loaded false so each toggle retries (fine today).
fix: Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> plus open flag.

title: StarPacksState keeps loading, loaded, error and open as separate fields
trigger: Open Stars, press Buy more Stars (maybe_fetch_star_packs sets loading=true, error=None), request fails or its continuation is dropped
effect: loading/loaded/error can combine (loading+error, loaded+error); a lost answer leaves loading=true with no retry for the session
fix: Replace loading/loaded/error/options with Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> (src/state/fetch.rs); keep open as a UI flag in OnScreen.

title: Star packs stage is open + loading + loaded + error + options
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Fetch<Vec<Pack>> plus the expanded flag in UI state.
